description.en: Specifies whether the image contains a person.

description.zh:
图片分类。取值范围：
- normal： 插图、文章配图。
- banner：背景图、轮播图。
- goods：商品或服务图
description.en:
The image category. Valid values:
- normal: illustrations or article images.
- banner: background images or carousel images.
- goods: product or service images.

The aspect ratio of the image. Valid values:
"16:9"
"4:3"
"2:1"
"1:1"
"3:4"
"9:16".
The maximum height of the image.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页行数。其中最大值为100行，默认值为20行。
description.en: The number of entries per page for paging queries. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 图片最大宽度(包含边界值)
description.en: The maximum width of the image, inclusive.
The minimum height of the image.

description.zh: 图片最小宽度（包含边界值）
description.en: The minimum width of the image, inclusive.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数。如果设置了NextToken，则请求参数PageSize和PageNumber将失效，且返回数据中的TotalCount无效。
description.en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request. If NextToken is specified, the PageSize and PageNumber request parameters do not take effect, and the TotalCount value in the response is invalid.
The number of returned results. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 返回结果的起始位置。取值范围：0~499。默认值为0。
description.en: The start position of the returned results. Valid values: 0 to 499. Default value: 0.

description.zh:
搜索图片的描述文本。

>最多支持512个字符。
description.en:
The description text used to search for images.

>Maximum length: 512 characters.
